title: Login button not responding on mobile

metadata.customer_impact: Cannot login on mobile - complete feature failure

description.summary: Login button doesn't respond when tapped on mobile Safari
description.observed_behavior: Button tap has no visible effect. Form does not submit.
description.expected_behavior: Should show loading indicator and proceed to dashboard on successful authentication.
description.additional_context: Bug does not occur on desktop browsers. Started after v2.1.0 deployment.

error_analysis.likely_cause: Form element not found in DOM - selector mismatch

hypothesis.description: Mobile Safari has different event handling
evidence: Tested with touchstart/touchend events - same behavior

hypothesis.description: Form element ID changed in recent commit
evidence: Git diff shows form ID changed from 'loginForm' to 'login-form' in commit abc123
DOM inspection confirms form element has new ID
hypothesis.conclusion: Confirmed - ID mismatch between HTML and JavaScript

root_cause.description: Commit abc123 changed form ID from 'loginForm' to 'login-form' as part of CSS BEM naming convention update, but JavaScript handler was not updated to match.

notes.author: john_developer
notes.content: Starting investigation. First will try to reproduce locally.

notes.author: john_developer
notes.content: Successfully reproduced on iPhone simulator. Same error in console.

notes.author: john_developer
notes.content: Found the issue - form ID mismatch. Recent BEM naming update changed HTML but not JS.

fix.description: Updated JavaScript to use new form ID 'login-form' instead of 'loginForm'

lessons_learned: Add automated tests that verify element IDs match between HTML and JavaScript
Update code review checklist to include cross-file reference checks
Consider using data attributes instead of IDs for JavaScript selectors
